note: cumulative per pass; dfsCalls = calls of countSolutions (one per uniqueness count, NOT depth-first node entries; node entries are not instrumented); dfsChecks = budget checks of the depth-first search loop (propagation checks are not included); restrictedSolves are calls of the allowed-set solve; skippedDfs is a count skipped by a complete sound proof (G1 only)

counterUnits.dfsCalls: calls of SG.dfs.countSolutions (one per uniqueness count, whatever its depth); NOT depth-first node entries
counterUnits.dfsChecks: budget checks of the depth-first search loop (`ws.budget.check()` in `search`); propagation checks are not included
counterUnits.restrictedSolves: calls of the allowed-set restricted solve (`solveWithin`)
counterUnits.countWithinCalls: calls of the digger's `countWithin` (keeper offers and the local search): one UNIQUE_NODES slice each
counterUnits.countWithinNodes: budget checks counted by the UNIQUE_NODES slices (search-loop AND propagation checks), not search nodes
